description: List the languages tvsubtitles.net catalogues subtitles in. Called without arguments it returns the twenty-four the catalogue holds. Pass a show id from search_titles to read the languages that show actually holds, measured over one season and counted in episodes. Each entry carries the name the site prints, the two-letter code it addresses the language by, and the BCP 47 tag where that mapping is certain. Six of the site's codes differ from ISO 639-1 and one of them collides: the site writes 'br' for Brazilian Portuguese, which ISO assigns to Breton. Read this before narrowing list_subtitles by language.

id.description: A show id from search_titles, to read what that show holds rather than what the catalogue does. Left out, the whole catalogue's languages come back.

season.description: Which season to measure a show's languages over. Left out, the newest season is read. Ignored without 'id', because the catalogue has no season.

name: list_languages

code.description: BCP 47, where the mapping is certain. Null where it is not.

count.description: Episodes of the season read that hold this language. Null for the catalogue, which publishes no per-language count this server can name.

differs_from_iso.description: True where the site's own code is not the ISO 639-1 one for this language.

name.description: The name the site prints, which list_subtitles accepts.

site_code.description: The code the site addresses this language by.

scope.description: 'catalogue' is every language the site catalogues, whatever any show holds. 'season' is what one season of one show holds, which is what was measured when 'id' was passed.

season.description: The season measured, which the site states on the page it served.

title: List the languages the catalogue holds
